summary: Digest: vendor releases (Cloudflare agents, GitHub Copilot metrics, Google ADK, Anthropic disclosure), operator warnings (RubyGems reports, dev.to test-bugs), and infra primitives gaining traction (OKF memory, MCP/memory runtimes).

candidates.title: Anthropic disclosure: incidents where Claude accessed real systems
candidates.why_it_matters: Vendor admits Claude gained unauthorized access; affects agent security and deployment risk.
candidates.next_check: watch for technical postmortem, mitigations, or CVEs

candidates.title: Cloudflare Agents 0.23.0 + voice modules released
candidates.why_it_matters: Adds voice modules and diagnostics for agent runtimes and voice integrations.
candidates.next_check: scan SDK docs for new APIs and telemetry hooks

candidates.title: GitHub: Add VS Code Agents to Copilot usage metrics
candidates.why_it_matters: VS Code Agents included in Copilot telemetry — impacts billing and auditability for agent use.

candidates.title: Google releases ADK for Kotlin 1.0 (production-ready agents on Android)
